prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1142; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the parking lot collision you were involved in in Conroe. Is it all right if we proceed?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please tell me in your own words what happened.

A: I was pulling out of a space near the front entrance of the store. It was busy, and I was backing slowly. I had just cleared the car next to me when another vehicle came down the aisle and hit the rear driver's side of my car.

Q: Were you moving at the time of impact?

A: Only slowly, maybe a few miles an hour. I had my foot on the brake for most of it, and I checked my mirror before I started.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?

A: Not really. I saw a glimpse of something white right before the impact, but I didn't have time to react.

Q: Did you have any injuries from the collision?

A: Yes. I hit my head against the window frame. I've been diagnosed with a concussion. I've had headaches, some dizziness, and I've been sleeping more than usual. My doctor has told me to limit screen time and rest.

Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?

A: Yes, I'm seeing my primary care doctor and I have a follow-up scheduled next week.

Q: Did you go to the emergency room or call for medical help at the scene?

A: I was checked by a paramedic at the scene and then went to urgent care later that afternoon.

Q: Is there anything else you want to add about the collision?

A: Just that I'm still having trouble concentrating, so if I seem slow answering, that's why. I'm cooperating fully and I'll send any records you need.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
